role: Senior Machine Learning Scientist - Agentic Modelling Team
company_profile: Booking.com is a global travel platform connecting travellers with accommodation, transport and experiences.
title: Senior Machine Learning Scientist
summary: Senior applied scientist with 8+ years taking ML and LLM systems from prototype to production, with an MSc in Machine Learning and AI. Designs production agentic systems in LangGraph, covering multi-agent patterns, multi-turn reasoning, tool orchestration and retrieval-augmented generation, and builds LLM evaluation with evaluators, tracing and failure detection to improve them systematically. Works cross-functionally with engineers and stakeholders to turn business requirements into ML-powered products. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

experience_edits.new: Engineered a production multi-agent analytics chatbot in LangGraph for AARP medical plans, combining multi-turn reasoning, PySpark analysis and live charts to answer business questions, cutting manual analysis by 98%.

experience_edits.new: Designed an internal retrieval-augmented Project Discovery Assistant in LangGraph, pairing semantic retrieval with LLM reasoning to reach a 90% match rate against existing organizational solutions.

experience_edits.new: Fine-tuned a cross-encoder on positive and negative pairs to re-rank dense retrieval over AARP survey data, improving retrieval accuracy for LLM applications.

project.name: Agent Memory and Planning Framework
bullets: Built a configurable agent framework in LangGraph for travel planning assistants, with session and long-term memory, iterative planning, self-correction and specialised sub-agents sharing context.
Compared agent strategies, prompts and models with an automated evaluation suite of LLM evaluators and tracing, then served the best configuration through FastAPI with MLflow tracking.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Senior Machine Learning Scientist role in the Agentic Modelling Team. My recent work has centred on agents in production: multi-agent systems in LangGraph, retrieval, and the evaluation that tells you whether a new strategy is really better. Years of classical ML before that still shape how I measure things.

Your team builds the platform that lets other teams compose their own agents, so a good idea on memory or planning improves every trip rather than one product. That reach is what draws me. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Amsterdam together and settle there long term.

At United Health Group I built a LangGraph multi-agent analytics chatbot that cut manual analysis by 98%, and evaluation pipelines with LLM evaluators and tracing that reduced human-in-the-loop review by 43%. I would bring that same loop of building, measuring and improving to agent strategies and memory systems, working closely with your ML engineers.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. Designing it around how students lose and regain context has shaped how I think about agent memory. I would be glad to talk about how I could contribute to the team.
